description: Original example records for the evidence-notes component. These do not report Granite model experiments or outcomes.

records.title: Comparison context
records.claim: A comparison needs a named baseline.
records.quote: State the alternative before interpreting a result.
records.detail: This example note holds the comparison context beside the sentence. A production version would link to the exact study protocol and identify which settings were held fixed.

records.title: Measurement unit
records.claim: Every percentage should point to a denominator.
records.quote: Keep the measurement unit attached to the reported value.
records.detail: This example stores a measurement definition. A production result would include the observed numerator, denominator, evaluation scope and source record. No model scores are supplied here.

records.title: Uncertainty context
records.claim: An estimate needs room for uncertainty.
records.quote: Attach the interval method and its scope to the estimate.
records.detail: This example describes where uncertainty context belongs. It provides no calculated interval. A production version would display the reported interval, resampling unit and method from the published study.

records.title: Scope boundary
records.claim: The boundary belongs beside the conclusion.
records.quote: Keep the qualification with the finding.
records.detail: This example makes the scope boundary inspectable without interrupting the paragraph. In a research result, that boundary should state which study, population and inference the evidence supports.
